name: reporting
description: 汇总各阶段产物与 Verification 结果，生成 execution-report.md，引用 spec / plan / test-plan 三份核心文档与本次 run 的关键事件。

prompt.instruction: Fill execution-report_template.md with: (a) run metadata from .state.json (runId, createdAt, currentStage, history); (b) per-stage artifact list from .state.json.stages[*].outputs; (c) verification summary derived from verification.log (count pass/fail); (d) 'Context missing' list from context-summary.md if present; (e) explicit links to spec.md, plan.md, test-plan.md.
guardrails: Do not invent stages that .state.json does not contain.
If verification.log is missing, write 'Verification not run' in that section.
